toy_15_state_convergence.description: Analytic 15-state CTMC experiment from Section 6.1 / Appendix D.1: high-order samplers should converge faster in KL than first-order tau-leaping under the same step budget.

mean_kl.description: Mean KL over the scored step budgets, rewarding methods that improve across the convergence grid rather than only at the largest budget.

total_variation_at_max_steps.description: Total variation distance to the analytic target at the largest scored step budget, a bounded distribution-quality check complementary to KL.

worst_state_abs_error_at_max_steps.description: Largest absolute state-probability error at the largest scored step budget, catching methods that hide poor tail-state behavior in aggregate KL.
